newsitem.title: BULGARIA: PRESS DIGEST -- BANKER BUSINESS WEEKLY -- MAY 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST -- BANKER BUSINESS WEEKLY -- MAY 5.

text.p: The following stories were reported in this week's issue of Banker newspaper:
-- Bulgaria's central bank is expected to cut further its main interest rate to 5.5 percent from the current 6.7 percent on the base of the yields of the last seven-day and 28-day T-bills auctions.
-- The International Monetary Fund (IMF) officials are optimistic about Bulgaria's reforms, the central bank governor Lyubomir Filipov said after a visit to the IMF headquarters in Washington.
-- ABN Amro Bank is expected to participate in the management of the Bulgarian Biochim Bank with whom it signed a twinning agreement last year.
-- An IMF mission is expected to arrive in Bulgaria in May to help start up a currency board sustem.
